correctness.rationale: Exact OU increment variance yields the stated integrable Green–Kubo kernel. Uniform small-inertia expansion is direct. The derivative of the negative kernel is unimodal, giving a two-integration-by-parts large-inertia O(tau^-1/2) bound at nonzero chirality. Small-chirality rescaling converges uniformly on positive compact scale ratios, with separate endpoint localization bounds; its Gaussian Fourier transform has a unique maximum at scale x=1. The all-maximizer conclusion and zero-chirality monotone divergence are consequently analytic; finite test results are supplementary.
